risks.risk: Actual screen size may be smaller than claimed 86 inches
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure or known-size object (e.g., a door, person) next to the TV for scale
risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed size, assume smaller common size until measured

risks.risk: Model number cannot be matched to claimed premium model
risks.proof: Clear photo of the back panel label showing model/serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded-model LG TV, not the specific high-end model claimed

risks.risk: Screen defects (dead pixels, lines, burn-in) not visible in static/demo images
risks.proof: Video panning across full white, red, green, blue, and black screens
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested screen condition, worst case minor defects assumed

risks.risk: Remote control may not actually be included
risks.proof: Photo of the physical remote alongside the TV

risks.risk: Soundbar and set-top box visible may or may not be part of the sale
risks.proof: Seller written confirmation plus photo clearly showing these items with the TV for sale

risks.risk: Physical damage to frame, back, ports, or mount bracket not shown
risks.proof: Photos of the back panel, edges, and all port connections
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/port condition unknown, worst case moderate wear

risks.risk: Age and warranty status unknown, affecting remaining useful life
risks.proof: Photo of purchase receipt, warranty card, or manufacture date sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as no warranty, unknown age

proof_requests: Photo of the back panel showing model number and serial sticker
Video scanning full screen in solid colors (white, red, green, blue, black) to check for dead pixels or lines
Photo with a measuring tape or known-size reference object against the screen for size verification
Photo of the remote control included in the sale
Clarification and photo confirming whether the soundbar and set-top box are included
Photos of the TV's back, edges, and ports showing physical condition
Photo of any purchase receipt or warranty document
response.reason: The witness confirms this is an LG smart TV, so it can be priced, but screen size, model, condition, and included accessories are all unverified and must be priced at worst case until the listed proofs are provided.
